data.title: Top 3 Price Prediction: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple – BTC, ETH and XRP await US NFP for next directional move | FXStreet
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH) and Ripple (XRP) extend their weekly gains on Friday as traders await the US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report for the next directional catalyst.
